findings.description: InProcessServer::shutdown consumes the JoinHandle inside timeout. If shutdown times out, dropping that handle detaches the axum server task while self.task is already None, so Drop cannot abort it; the listener/background task can remain alive after the test.

The movement assertion verifies one matching update on socket B but never proves that socket B receives no duplicate or out-of-order update, so the stated single ordered peer update is only an at-least-one assertion.
